build_name: HealthyMe v25 Body-Mind State Sync Fix
scope: Replaced raw HTML dashboard card wrappers with native Streamlit bordered containers.
Restored proper card structure for Today's Priority and Main Workflows.
Kept microcopy inside the same card as its action, so second line does not appear detached.
Removed Recommended Flow expander to eliminate '-a' expand/collapse artifact.
Replaced expander with always-visible compact flow card to avoid scroll-jump after expansion.
Unified build text to v14 aliases.
latest_fix: Admin Assessment records activation request and syncs visibility after final completion.
Body-Mind Access Control can record activation request before final completion.
When final admin completion happens, Body-Mind unlocks if request exists.
Explicit disable clears both request and visibility.
No scoring, final report calculation, auth structure, or database schema changed.
required_setup: Set GitHub Actions secret or variable WAKEME_URLS to the deployed Streamlit app URL
salary_management_system_learnings_appli: secret and variable are read separately
extra safety cron around 10:00 AM IST
workflow uses inline Python and no Node-based actions
root_cause: The app had only body_mind_unlocked, but did not reliably preserve that admin had requested activation before final admin completion.
If admin selected Body-Mind activation before completion, the request could be lost or not applied after final completion.
This caused Member Home to show recipes/exercises while Body-Mind stayed hidden.
testing_required: Case 1: Request Body-Mind before final admin completion, then complete admin final assessment; member should see Body-Mind.
Case 2: Complete admin final assessment first, then activate Body-Mind from Body-Mind Access Control; member should see Body-Mind.
Case 3: Disable explicitly from Body-Mind Access Control; member should not see Body-Mind.
business_rule: Body-Mind activates only when admin final assessment is complete and admin selects Body-Mind activation from either approved path.
Disabling remains explicit through Body-Mind Access Control.
